title: Room 14
description:
You are inside an endless School but there is a way you can escape. Search in the hallways 

of the school and find the changes within them to reach Room 14.

If you find anomalies, turn around! 

If you think the room is normal continue to the exit.

To get to Room 14.

Room 14 is a small walking simulator inspired by the backrooms and liminal spaces.

- Endless Hotel -

- 7 Shaders -

- 30+ Anomalies -

This experience can last up to 15 - 60 minutes 

It can last longer if you playthrough the game with the different shaders and if find all of the anomalies.
 

Asset Credits
